name: Amazon US
description: Amazon US public product details, photos, specifications, variants, displayed review totals, search, suggestions, featured offers, sellers, stock and batch prices.

tools.name: Offer
tools.description: Get the featured buy-box offer for one Amazon.com ASIN or product URL: displayed price, list price and savings, boolean in-stock state with Amazon's availability text, seller and shipper, item condition, delivery promise, coupon and other-offers hints. Unknown values are null.

options.name: asin
options.about: Ten-character Amazon Standard Identification Number, e.g. B09B8V1LZ3. Supply this or url. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]{10}$.

options.name: url
options.about: HTTPS Amazon.com /dp/ASIN or /gp/product/ASIN URL. Supply this or asin.

response.about: Get the featured buy-box offer for one Amazon.com ASIN or product URL: displayed price, list price and savings, boolean in-stock state with Amazon's availability text, seller and shipper, item condition, delivery promise, coupon and other-offers hints. Unknown values are null.

fields.name: offer_state
fields.about: featured_offer: a buy-box price is displayed; unavailable: Amazon states the item cannot be bought; see_all_buying_options: no featured offer, only the all-offers list; unknown: neither signal present.

fields.name: redirected
fields.about: true when served_asin differs from asin; price and stock then describe served_asin.

fields.name: served_asin
fields.about: ASIN Amazon actually rendered. Differs from asin when Amazon answers a child ASIN with a sibling variant (HTTP 200).

tools.name: Variants
tools.description: List the variant dimensions (color, size, style...) and sibling ASINs of an Amazon.com product, with the swatch availability flag Amazon renders. Set include_prices to also fetch the buy-box price and stock state of the selected ASIN and up to max_priced-1 sibling ASINs.

options.name: asin
options.about: Ten-character Amazon Standard Identification Number, e.g. B09B8V1LZ3. Supply this or url. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]{10}$.

options.name: include_prices
options.about: Fetch each priced variant's product page for price and stock. Costs one upstream request per variant.

options.name: max_priced
options.about: Upper bound on variants (including the selected one) that receive an offer summary when include_prices is true.

options.name: url
options.about: HTTPS Amazon.com /dp/ASIN or /gp/product/ASIN URL. Supply this or asin.

response.about: List the variant dimensions (color, size, style...) and sibling ASINs of an Amazon.com product, with the swatch availability flag Amazon renders. Set include_prices to also fetch the buy-box price and stock state of the selected ASIN and up to max_priced-1 sibling ASINs.

fields.name: served_asin
fields.about: ASIN Amazon actually rendered. Differs from asin when Amazon answers a child ASIN with a sibling variant (HTTP 200).
